text: Select: DISTINCT m.chembl_id AS CHEMBL_ID, m.pref_name AS preferred_name, m.max_phase AS maximum_phase, m.molecule_type AS molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles AS SMILES; Source: molecule_dictionary m, compound_records cr, docs d, compound_structures cs; Join: m.molregno = cr.molregno AND cr.doc_id = d.doc_id AND m.molregno = cs.molregno; Filter: d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1133022'; Sort: ; Limit: ;
